historical_record.description: The Church of Our Lady of Kazan was incorporated in 1950 and established here; it was later remodelled by architects V. Daniloff and W. Granitow for a growing congregation, and its interior frescoes were painted by Archimandrite Kiprian of Jordanville Monastery.
The Office of the Assessor-Recorder photographed the property for tax assessment. Our Lady of Kazan Russian Orthodox Church was at the address.

unknowns.rebuilt-since-photograph: The assessor dates the building to 1967, after this photograph was taken.
